answer: Mutual cover charges $150 per identity into a shared vault and issues a relic receipt tracing its funding trail. Cover sleeps through a 30-day voyage of verified jobs. Three rotating auditors sweep 5% of members each epoch; victim claims trigger instant audits. One caught clone lets the sweep follow its relic trail, burn every linked cover, and fine each member $150 times the ring size. A 100-clone ring pays $1,500,000; one honest agent risks $150, refunded when clean. Splitting identities widens the blast, and a convoy insuring itself together loses every ship when one hull rots.
